Description: Overview: replaced the flat 4-cell stat grid with a real dashboard — hero KPI strip (Total users WoW delta, Posts 30d MoM delta, Paying subscribers, Active users), 30-day signups vs posts area chart, paying/free subscription split bar, recent activity feed and latest signups list. Backend /api/admin/stats now returns prev-period deltas and /api/admin/stats/series returns daily zero-filled series (fixed timezone bug where posts showed on the wrong day). Feedback: replaced ComingSoon with a real page — filters (status + category), search, count, Export CSV button, and feedback cards with Mark as read / Close / Reopen actions.

New /admin/support triage page (summary strip, search, filters, table sorted by priority/status/recency, kebab actions, inline priority menu) and /admin/support/[id] detail page (back link, original request, chat-style conversation, details meta card, staff reply composer with image upload). New user-facing /dashboard/support table with New ticket dialog and /dashboard/support/[id] detail page (chat-style thread, drag-and-drop / Cmd-V paste image composer, mark-resolved button, auto-reopen on reply). Image attachments: migration 0022 adds attachment_url columns, new /api/support/upload (multer, 5 MB, jpg/png/webp/gif), reusable AttachmentInput, inline previews in messages. Migration 0023 adds last_viewed_at (unread blue dot on the table) and rating (1-5 star CSAT prompt once resolved). All backend endpoints in /api/admin/support and /api/support implemented.

Added ProfileAvatar widget to the My profile section in /admin/settings (camera-on-hover, 2.5 MB cap) reusing the existing /api/users/me/avatar endpoint. Bumped Next server-action body limit to 5 MB so uploads work. updateProfileAction / changePasswordAction / uploadAvatarAction now revalidate both /dashboard/settings and /admin/settings so fields refresh after save. Sidebar dropdown: hid Upgrade/Support/Send feedback group for ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN; profile preview at the top is now clickable and routes to /admin/settings or /dashboard/settings depending on role.

Brand-colored platform icons on /admin/content (LinkedIn blue, Facebook blue, Instagram pink, Pinterest red, Reddit orange, Bluesky blue). Status badge palette refresh — Open emerald, Pending amber, Resolved sky, Closed muted. Priority dot has an animate-ping signal halo on Urgent and High. Subscriptions invoices and charges rows now have a Download link next to View (PDF for invoices, receipt URL for charges).

Traced why Recent activity views/likes show 0 even for 3-day-old posts. Pipeline (client get-analytics-summary → server /api/analytics/summary → fetchAndSnapshotAnalytics → Late /analytics?postId=…) is correct; aggregator filters out platforms with syncStatus pending/unavailable. Raw Late response confirms LinkedIn analytics are stuck on syncStatus: pending for every multi-platform crosspost (single-platform LinkedIn posts sync fine), Pinterest reports synced-but-zero engagement, Twitter rows failed due to 280-char overflow. Action item lives on Late's side — not a client bug.

Status: Added next-themes with attribute=class + defaultTheme=light + enableSystem. Full .dark token block in globals.css mirroring :root (background, card, popover, sidebar, brand, status badges, chart, platform colors, weekend tint). Switched hardcoded sidebar icon color to var(--sidebar-foreground) with opacity so icons follow the theme. Theme picker lives inside the sidebar user dropdown (Palette submenu → Light / Dark / System with a check on the active option), not in the header. suppressHydrationWarning on <html>. Sonner inherits system theme.

Description: Bounded the ticket detail page to 100svh-6.5rem on lg+ so the conversation no longer pushes the page chrome to scroll. Slimmed TicketHeader to back link + title + ticket id only (removed the giant Original request card that was eating half the viewport). Synthesized the ticket body as the first TicketReply and prepended it to the thread, so the original request now renders as the first chat bubble (Intercom/Linear pattern). New TicketThreadMessages client component scrolls internally and auto-scrolls to bottom on mount and on new replies. Composer is pinned at the bottom of the card — users no longer have to scroll-hunt to find the input. Details panel scrolls in its own column. Capped reply attachment images at max-w-xs / max-h-56 with object-cover so they can't blow out the bubble.
